keyEvents.text: Josh Laurent (Burnley) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Queens Park Rangers 0, Burnley 1. Largie Ramazani (Burnley) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jamie Vardy.
Jonathan Varane (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for handball.
Substitution, Burnley. Aaron Ramsey replaces Marcus Edwards.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Rayan Kolli replaces Richard Kone.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Ilias Chair replaces Koki Saito.
Goal! Queens Park Rangers 1, Burnley 1. Jonathan Varane (Queens Park Rangers) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ilias Chair.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Karamoko Dembélé replaces Harvey Vale.
Substitution, Burnley. Josh Cullen replaces Reo Hatate.
Substitution, Burnley. Jaydon Banel replaces Andréas Hountondji.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Justin Obikwu replaces Paul Smyth.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Boy Kemper replaces Dennis Cirkin.
Substitution, Burnley. Oliver Sonne replaces Jamie Vardy.
Oliver Sonne (Burnley) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Queens Park Rangers 1, Burnley 1.
